description: This PHP source file defines the 'MultipartUploader' class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling multipart uploads to Amazon S3 and Glacier. It includes configuration options, methods for creating upload parts, and handling data streams.

classes.name: MultipartUploader
classes.description: Encapsulates the execution of a multipart upload to S3 or Glacier, providing methods to configure, initiate, and manage multipart uploads including creating parts and handling data streams.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MultipartUploader with the AWS S3 client, source data, and configuration options.

methods.name: loadUploadWorkflowInfo
methods.description: Loads and returns workflow command information for initiating, uploading parts, and completing the multipart upload.

methods.name: createPart
methods.description: Creates a data part for upload, handling data stream sourcing, size checks, and optional checksum calculation.

methods.name: extractETag
methods.description: Extracts the ETag from the upload result, used for verifying the uploaded part.

methods.name: getSourceMimeType
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of the source data based on the filename.

methods.name: getSourceSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the source data being uploaded.

methods.name: decorateWithHashes
methods.description: Decorates a stream with a SHA256 hashing layer to compute and attach a hash to the upload.
